sources.text: The authorized owners signed off the December privileged-account review on 2026-12-29. Every hosted production account was included; the review is finished.
The authorized owners scheduled the December review of all hosted production privileged accounts for 2026-12-29. This memo records the plan only; it gives no account of whether the review occurred.

The December privileged-account review covered all AWS production accounts and was completed by approved owners on 2026-12-28. For on-premises production accounts, this report provides no review completion information.
Approved owners completed the December privileged-account review for every hosted production account. The completion-date field reads 01/02/2027; no date-format convention is specified.

Approved owners completed the December privileged-account review for every AWS production account on 2026-12-30. Separately, approved owners completed the December review for every on-premises production account on 2027-01-04.
